name: PIRA-Bench
intro: PIRA-Bench 面向无显式指令的主动式 GUI 意图推荐。它整理 100 条真实移动端和桌面端连续轨迹，为每条轨迹注入应用切换、空闲屏幕和随机浏览噪声并配对三种用户画像，再由三名独立标注者确定可行动意图，形成直接推荐、画像依赖和纯噪声负样本三类场景。
org: MMLab @ CUHK, Nankai University, Huawei Research
build_method: 真实连续GUI轨迹, 噪声注入, 三用户画像配对, 三人独立意图标注
metric: Average Intent F1, Normalized False Positive Score, Final Score
eval_feature: 画像条件意图, 纯噪声负样本, 语义集合匹配, 误报惩罚
scale: 100条轨迹, 平均32张截图, 每条轨迹3个用户画像
intro_en: PIRA-Bench evaluates proactive GUI intent recommendation without explicit user instructions. It curates 100 real mobile and desktop trajectories, injects application switching, idle screens, and random browsing noise, pairs each trajectory with three user profiles, and uses three independent annotators to establish actionable intents across direct, profile-dependent, and pure-noise negative scenarios.
build_method_en: Real Sequential GUI Trajectories, Noise Injection, Three-profile Pairing, Three-person Independent Intent Annotation
metric_en: Average Intent F1, Normalized False Positive Score, Final Score
eval_feature_en: Profile-conditioned Intents, Pure-noise Negatives, Semantic Set Matching, False-positive Penalty
scale_en: 100 trajectories, 32 screenshots on average, 3 user profiles per trajectory
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从真实移动端与桌面端操作中收集长轨迹截图"] --> B["按轨迹切分连续 GUI 状态并保留时序"]
    B --> C["为每条轨迹配对 3 个不同用户画像"]
    C --> D["标注可行动意图、噪声片段与多线程任务切换"]
    D --> E["构建直接推荐、画像依赖和无意图负样本三类场景"]
    E --> F["让模型仅基于连续截图与画像主动推荐意图"]
    F --> G["分别计算 Intent F1 与误报惩罚"]
    G --> H["汇总 Average Intent F1、FPSnorm 与 Final Score"]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect long GUI trajectories from real mobile and desktop activity"] --> B["Segment each trajectory into time-ordered screenshot states"]
    B --> C["Pair every trajectory with three distinct user profiles"]
    C --> D["Annotate actionable intents, noisy segments, and multi-thread task switches"]
    D --> E["Build direct-intent, profile-dependent, and no-intent scenarios"]
    E --> F["Ask models to proactively recommend intents from screenshots and profiles alone"]
    F --> G["Compute intent quality and false-positive penalties separately"]
    G --> H["Aggregate Average Intent F1, FPSnorm, and the final score"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.08013's benchmark construction and evaluation sections plus the official PIRA-Bench leaderboard. The diagrams preserve 100 real mobile and desktop trajectories, an average of 32 sequential screenshots, injected application-switching, idle-screen, and random-browsing noise, three socioeconomic/preference/characteristic profiles per trajectory, direct, profile-dependent, and pure-noise scenarios, three independent human intent annotations, two-of-three agreement, empty intent sets for negative cases, no-explicit-instruction prediction, Gemini-3-flash semantic matching, macro Average Intent F1, normalized false-positive score 1/(1+ln(1+FPS)), and multiplicative Final Score.
